full_text: (a) The municipality may levy fees for the sealing and licensing of weights and measures at such reasonable rates as shall be prescribed by the Sangguniang Bayan. (b) The Sangguniang bayan shall prescribe the necessary regulations for the use of such weights and measures, subject to such guidelines as shall be prescribed by the Department of Science and Technology. The Sanggunian concerned shall, by appropriate ordinance, penalize fraudulent practices and unlawful possession or use of instruments of weights and measures and prescribe the criminal penalty therefore in accordance with the provisions of this Code. Provided, however, That the Sanggunian concerned may authorize the municipal treasurer to settle an offense not involving the commission of fraud before a case therefore is files in court, upon payment of a compromise penalty of not less than Two hundred pesos (P200.00).
